newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: AB Airlines to meet Shannon-Gatwick route target.
newsitem.headline: AB Airlines to meet Shannon-Gatwick route target.

text.p: AB Airlines said on Wednesday that its subsidiary AB Shannon was on track to meet its target of 100,000 passengers in the first year of its Gatwick-Shannon route.
"August was particularly good with 13,500 passengers carried at a load factor of 80 percent," AB chief executive Brian Beal told a news conference in Shannon, in the west of Ireland.
Beal said the load factor indicated that more capacity was needed for the peak months of next year.
"Currently, we are looking at increasing from three to four daily services but this is entirely dependent on gaining extra slots at Gatwick," he said.
AB Shannon is also introducing a new business class service on the Gatwick-Shannon route, Beal said.
